## Checks

Control take: AUC (%) of the control take (normal, after a remount) against the same-mount normals; about 50 means the model does not hear the remount. Drift: AUC (%) of the later half of the same-mount normals against the earlier half; about 50 means no drift over the take. CNN only: training accuracy at the last epoch (%, counted on mixup-blended inputs) and the share (%) of normalised inputs outside the training range, which the int8 input would clip.

## The andon light

Phase 5 settings, limits fitted per fan on the limit clips. Reds per hour on the same-mount normals, and apart on the control take: after a remount, without recalibrating, which is not a pass condition (the rule is to recalibrate). Takes caught: fault takes that turned the light red, of those not flagged; seconds to red: the mean over the caught takes, from the start of the first scored fault clip, played straight after normal clips (a join, not the real onset: underspeed's first 30 s after the switch are not used, and the card is fitted with the fan off). Mean ± sample std over seeds.
